steps.en: Install it together with the deep-learning engine you want
steps.zh: 连同想用的深度学习引擎一起安装
steps.code: pip install deepface[tensorflow] · pip install deepface[pytorch]

steps.en: Call one function on two photos
steps.zh: 对两张照片调用一个函数

steps.en: On first use, downloads the chosen model's pretrained weights and caches them locally
steps.zh: 第一次用时下载所选模型的预训练权重，缓存到本地

steps.en: Finds and straightens the face in each image (OpenCV detector by default)
steps.zh: 在每张图里找到人脸并摆正（默认用 OpenCV 检测器）

steps.en: Turns each face into a vector (VGG-Face by default) and checks their distance against a pre-tuned threshold
steps.zh: 把每张脸变成一串数字（默认 VGG-Face），距离与预调阈值比较

value.en: One call answers "same person?" — you never assemble detection, alignment, embedding and threshold tuning yourself
value.zh: 一次调用回答“是不是同一个人”，不必自己拼检测、对齐、提特征和调阈值

sources: https://github.com/serengil/deepface README: Installation (pip install deepface[tensorflow] / [pytorch]), Face Verification (DeepFace.verify(img1_path = "img1.jpg", img2_path = "img2.jpg")), 'OpenCV is the default detector and alignment is on by default', 'The default configuration uses VGG-Face model'
deepface/config/threshold.py (pre-tuned thresholds per model and distance metric)
